text:
gwen: Quick FYI — PR #21877 is green locally and docs updated. It's blocked on nightly CI (flaky db migration test) and I'd prefer to land in the morning rolling-deploy window rather than during tonight's blackout. Can we swap it into the 09:00 rollover tomorrow?

aj: Are we sure it needs to wait for the rebase window? If it's just the one flaky test maybe we can merge with canary flag.

gwen: There's a tiny rebase (conflict in schema test fixture) — takes 2m. Canary would be fine but ops asked for rollovers for schema changes.

kevin: I'm +1 on rolling into the 09:00 slot if we can guarantee the quick rebase. Also need one more approver. @jordan can you give a quick look? :eyes:

ci-bot: nightly-ci — build #3321 failed: migration_integration_test::test_rollback (flaky)
logs: https://ci.example.com/build/3321 (rerun with `/rerun nightly-ci`)

release-coordinator: Gwen, if we move it to the 09:00 rollover we need the rebase done by 08:30 and approvals by 08:45 so oncall can queue the rollover. Can you do that timeline?

gwen: Yep — I'll rebase now and ping when done. Planning to run `/rerun nightly-ci` once rebase is up.

aj: I'll double-check the migration fixture after your rebase.

kevin: If ci-bot still fails after rerun, please paste the failing stack snippet here. We can hotfix the test with a tiny tolerance change if it's genuinely flaky.

jordan: gave a quick review, left one minor comment about test naming, but approve otherwise. +1 — can merge once rebase and CI green.

gwen: Rebase complete (pushed). Rerunning nightly: `/rerun nightly-ci` executed.

ci-bot: nightly-ci — build #3322 queued -> running.

ci-bot: nightly-ci — build #3322 passed ✅

kevin: Nice. @release-coordinator we meet the 08:30 rebase / 08:45 approval timeline. Please schedule the 09:00 rollover for PR #21877.

release-coordinator: Scheduled into 09:00 rollover. Tagging oncall for visibility: @sre-oncall.

gwen: Thanks everyone — merging after release window handoff. :tada:
